_note: Bridge artifact for the layout stage. Each page = the right-page illustration (from scenes.json) + the left-page English + (animal pages) one Amharic vocab word. The layout agent autofills the Kokeba page template in Canva with these fields, then exports a print-ready PDF (Canva embeds the Ethiopic font).

pages.english:
Good morning, Eden, sleepyhead.
Time to wake and leave your bed.

Shoes on feet, bow in hair.
Off to the zoo— we're almost there!

A lion stands strong and proud.
"ROAR!" says Eden, big and loud.

An elephant stomps down the way.
His trunk waves high to say, "Good day!"

A monkey swings from tree to tree.
"Ee-ee-ee!" chatters he.

A giraffe stretches to the sky.
Its long neck reaches way up high.

A camel walks with bumpity bump.
Wiggle and giggle— look at that hump!

A hippo splashes in the pool.
Splashing water is very cool!

A leopard tiptoes soft and slow.
Where is it going? Nobody knows.

We saw animals, big and small.
Eden's favorite? She loved them all!

The bus rolls home. The sky turns blue.
Eden waves, "Bye-bye, zoo!"
She smiles at Mommy and starts to say,
"Can we come back another day?"
Kokeba ★ — A story for every little star.
